conditions:
Andrew bought 27 little cubes of the same color, each with three adjacent faces painted red and the other three of another color. He wants to use all these little cubes to build a bigger cube. What is the largest number of completely red faces that he can get for this cube?

answer_verification.reasoning: Six is both the maximum number of faces of the large cube and achievable: orient each corner cube with its three red faces outward, each edge cube with two red faces outward, each face-center cube with one red face outward, and the interior cube arbitrarily. Every cube has three adjacent red faces, so these local requirements can all be met independently. Thus all six outer faces can be completely red.
